title: Gateway role configuration and role prompt contracts
description: Blueprint section 9.13 (GatewayRole, GatewayCall) and section 9.16 (the typed JSON envelope of every model role and the recorded replay): no code path outside the gateway module may call a provider (asserted by a static import audit in CI), the verifier's request never contains the question (asserted by a recorded-call test), every prompt is a versioned file prompts/<role>/v<N>.md whose SHA-256 is the prompt_version recorded on every trace, draft and evaluation run, and every role receives its inputs inside a typed JSON envelope with named fields and is told that every field is data; no field is ever concatenated into an instruction string.

GatewayRole.title: GatewayRole
GatewayRole.description: One configuration row per model role. additionalProperties is false and is the whole point of the row: the application parses every row of its ROLE_TABLE against this type at module load (src/gateway/config.ts), so a field outside this list is a load failure and not a silent pass. The per-role pins follow ADR-001 as overridden by deviation D-05 (every product model role AG-1 to AG-4 runs glm-5.3-flash on the one provider, https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4, OpenAI-compatible, api_style openai_chat, thinking always_on, response_format json_object; effort high for AG-1 and AG-3, low for AG-2 and AG-4) and, for the embedding role, the verified probe of 2026-09-03 (embedding-3 is not served on api.z.ai, so the embedding role is a hash-pinned local open-weights model run through ONNX, ADR-009 second branch: provider local_embedding, api_style local_onnx, model_id the corpus version's pin corpus_version.embedding_model with embedding_dim and the model file hash, thinking n/a, effort n/a, response_format n/a, temperature null, prompt_version null). GLM reasoning cannot be disabled, so thinking is always_on and effort is the explicit per-role setting; every chat call sets response_format json_object (ADR-001). Those pins were carried until now as a five-branch allOf of if/then blocks whose then held nothing but JSON Schema default annotations, so it constrained nothing; json-schema-to-zod rendered each branch as an intersection with z.any(), and in Zod 4 an intersection with z.any() cancels the strict object, which turned the load-time check into a check that could not fail. The pins are stated here instead, as the annotation they always were, and the strictness they were quietly cancelling is back.

timeout_ms.description: milliseconds; never above the Vercel Hobby function maximum duration of 300 s (verified 2026-09-03), which bounds every call including the waitUntil drafting work of ADR-004

retries.description: OUTSIDE the GatewayRole key list of blueprint 9.13, and the only key here that is. Retries inside one logical call, on a timeout or a retryable provider error; absent means the gateway default MAX_RETRIES (src/gateway/index.ts). AG-3 and AG-4/redline set it to 0, buying a longer per-attempt cut by giving up their retries so the drafting round closes inside its lease. It is declared because the application's ROLE_TABLE carries it and this row is parsed at load: until the strictness above was restored it passed unseen, and the choice is to declare it or to drop it from the table. Not in required: a role that says nothing takes the default.

GatewayCall.title: GatewayCall
GatewayCall.description: One record per provider call, stored with the trace or the draft: model id, prompt version, gateway configuration hash and corpus version on every call (blueprint 8.1).

AG1Input.title: AG1Input
AG1Input.description: AG-1 Extractor (build time) input envelope. Rules: anchor_text must be an exact substring of the page text (verified by the parser, a miss drops the claim); entity_binding is a member of candidate_entities or NONE; no numeral may appear in value_text that is not inside anchor_text; the reviewed output is committed and never regenerated during a build.

candidate_entities.description: closed set of ids for this document's asset

AG1Output.title: AG1Output
AG1Output.description: AG-1 Extractor output envelope; the parser drops any claim whose anchor_text is not an exact substring of the page text, and a claim becomes a Claim row of 9.2 only through that check.

entity_binding.description: string | "NONE"; a member of candidate_entities or NONE

AG2Input.title: AG2Input
AG2Input.description: AG-2 Composer (runtime) input envelope. Rules: extractive first; every claim names at least one span_id from the evidence; no entity and no numeral absent from the evidence or the typed facts (gate C3 removes any that slip); a repair call receives the verdicts and may only drop or reword the sentences the verdicts named.

repair.description: null on the first composition; on the one repair round it carries the AG-4 verdicts of the sentences to drop or reword

AG2Output.title: AG2Output
AG2Output.description: AG-2 Composer output envelope; every claim names at least one span_id from the evidence (minItems 1); the gate, not the composer, decides the outcome.

AG3Input.title: AG3Input
AG3Input.description: AG-3 Drafter (runtime, asynchronous) input envelope: the debt cluster, its typed evidence and the six-section house template with header fields.

template.description: the six-section house template with header fields

AG3Output.title: AG3Output
AG3Output.description: AG-3 Drafter output envelope. Rules: every element carries provenance or is a slot whose text is exactly REQUIRES ENGINEER INPUT; a numeral appears only with a numeric_provenance entry; sections 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 may not reproduce a work-order narrative field verbatim (the verbatim check blocks the draft); section 5 quotes rows with their work-order ids; the drafter never fills a slot and never writes an SME note.

header.description: the header fields of the six-section house template

AG4VerifyInput.title: AG4VerifyInput
AG4VerifyInput.description: AG-4 Verifier input envelope (question-blind, its own prompt): the question is never present; additionalProperties false makes any other field a schema failure. Rules: one batched call per artefact; a verdict that fails to parse counts as not_entailed; the gate makes every decision and the verifier makes none.

AG4VerifyOutput.title: AG4VerifyOutput
AG4VerifyOutput.description: AG-4 Verifier output envelope; the verdicts are copied onto AnswerTrace.verifier_verdicts (9.7) and, on a repair round, into AG2Input.repair.

AG4RedlineInput.title: AG4RedlineInput
AG4RedlineInput.description: AG-4 Redliner input envelope: the AG-3 output, the evidence references and the template rules; the redliner has no edit field in its schema.

AG4RedlineOutput.title: AG4RedlineOutput
AG4RedlineOutput.description: AG-4 Redliner output envelope: a verdict and reasons only, no edit field; the reasons take the shape of RedlineVerdict.reasons (9.6), which is where they are stored.

EmbeddingInput.title: EmbeddingInput
EmbeddingInput.description: embedding role input; rules: the model name and dimension are the corpus version's pin; chunks and queries use the same model.

EmbeddingOutput.title: EmbeddingOutput
EmbeddingOutput.description: embedding role output; one vector per input text, each of length corpus_version.embedding_dim.

Recording.title: Recording
Recording.description: Recorded replay: recordings/<case_id>/<role>.json; Tier B replays them in pull-request CI and refreshes them, as a reviewed commit, whenever a prompt version or a pin changes.

request.description: the role's input envelope as sent

response.description: the role's output envelope as returned

prompt_version.description: null for the embedding role, which has no prompt
